issues.legal_issue: A jagirdar is entitled to compensation for trees growing on granted land when the grant includes ownership of the land and no forest notification extinguished or restricted the jagirdar’s rights to the trees.
material_facts: The jagir was abolished under the applicable abolition legislation, and the jagirdar claimed compensation for teak trees on the granted lands.
The grant and the evidence supported the finding that the jagirdar held the villages absolutely and owned the land and things growing on it.
There was no evidence that the teak trees had been declared reserved trees or that a forest notification applied to the lands and restricted the jagirdar’s rights to the trees.
The compensation authorities denied compensation for the trees, but the High Court held that compensation was payable.
issues.conclusion: The jagirdar was entitled to compensation for the teak trees, and the State’s appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Section 11 of the Bombay Merged Territories and Areas (Jagirs Abolition) Act, 1954, compensation was payable for trees or structures on the land. A holder with absolute rights to the land was entitled to what grew on it unless those rights had been extinguished or restricted by a notification under the Indian Forest Act. Shri U.R. Mavinkurve v. Thakor Madhavsingh Gambhirsingh was distinguishable because a notification under Section 34(a) of that Act had declared the relevant lands to be forests and restricted the jagirdar’s rights; the Bombay Land Revenue Code, 1879, also did not confer a right to cut and remove trees from forest lands merely through occupancy rights.

rule.if: jagir_abolition_compensation_appeal and absolute_grant_includes_land_growth and trees_grow_on_granted_land and not forest_notification_restricted_tree_rights

predicates.jagir_abolition_compensation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning denial of compensation for trees following abolition of a jagir.
predicates.absolute_grant_includes_land_growth: The grant and evidence establish that the holder owned the granted land and things growing on it.
predicates.trees_grow_on_granted_land: The trees for which compensation is claimed grow on the granted land.
predicates.forest_notification_restricted_tree_righ: An applicable forest notification declared the land to be forest and extinguished or restricted the holder’s rights to the trees.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns compensation for trees after jagir abolition, the holder owned the granted land and its growth, and no applicable forest notification restricted the tree rights, compensation for the trees is payable.
